rationale: Pins the superclass-list split: `classdef Multi < BaseOne & BaseTwo & matlab.mixin.Copyable` makes Multi a subclass of BaseOne (extends) and conformant to the additional superclasses (implements). The FIRST base is never implements, and a later base is never extends. The dotted spelling `matlab.mixin.Copyable` is ONE target: the grammar's `superclasses` holds `property_name` nodes (dots inside one name), and a base must never be split into its package segments.
